content_sections.text: The APPSC Group 2 online application process will begin on 10 November 2026. Candidates must submit their applications by 30 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. The detailed notification is scheduled to be available on or before 10 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum educational qualification for most APPSC Group 2 posts is a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university. However, Finance and Law Assistant Section Officer posts and Accountant positions have specific qualification conditions. Qualification Cut-off: Candidates must possess the required qualification on the date of the detailed notification. Graduates from a recognized university can apply for Post Codes 01 to 08, subject to the remaining eligibility conditions. These include Deputy Tahsildar, Municipal Commissioner, Sub-Registrar and several other posts. However, the Finance and Law Assistant Section Officer posts and Accountant posts have additional or specific qualification requirements. Candidates applying for Sub-Registrar Grade-II must possess a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university. The notification gives preference to candidates who also hold a recognized Law degree. Candidates applying for Assistant Section Officer in the Finance Department must possess a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Economics or Commerce from a recognized university, or an accepted equivalent qualification. Applicants for Assistant Section Officer in the Law Department must possess a Bachelor's degree in Law from a recognized university or an accepted equivalent qualification. For Senior Accountant and Junior Accountant posts, the notification specifies Commerce, Economics or Mathematics degrees and also provides eligibility through other recognized degrees with the prescribed computer-related certificate qualifications, or specified computer-related degrees. The accepted certificate course examinations conducted by the Board of Technical Education and Training, Andhra Pradesh, include: Office Automation. PC Maintenance and Trouble Shooting. Web Designing. Candidates should compare their exact degree and certificate combination with the detailed eligibility provisions before applying for Post Codes 11 and 12. Candidates applying for Prohibition and Excise Sub-Inspector under Post Code 07 must satisfy the physical requirements prescribed for the post. APPSC has directed applicants to refer to the detailed notification for these requirements.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The APPSC Group 2 recruitment notification provides for an offline OMR-based Screening Test and a Main Examination. The annexure also contains a Computer Proficiency Test scheme. Candidates should check the detailed notification for the complete post-wise selection rules. The preliminary screening examination will be conducted offline in objective-type OMR format. The test contains 150 questions for 150 marks, with a duration of 150 minutes. The main examination consists of two objective-type papers carrying 150 marks each, for a total of 300 marks. The brief notification includes a Computer Proficiency Test scheme covering computer operations and office automation. The applicability of this test to individual posts should be confirmed from the detailed notification.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The APPSC Group 2 examination scheme includes a 150-mark Screening Test and a 300-mark Main Examination. The notification prescribes negative marking of one-third of the marks assigned to each incorrect answer. Exam Mode: Offline OMR-based examination. Negative Marking: One-third of the marks prescribed for a question will be deducted for each incorrect answer in the Screening Test and Main Examination.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The APPSC Group 2 syllabus includes Indian History, Geography, Indian Society, Current Affairs, Mental Ability, Andhra Pradesh History, Indian Constitution, Economy and Science and Technology. Indus Valley Civilization and Vedic Age. Buddhism and Jainism. Mauryan and Gupta Empires. Delhi Sultanate and Mughal Empire. Bhakti and Sufi Movements. Rise of the Maratha Empire. 1857 Revolt and Indian National Movement. Post-Independence Consolidation and Reorganization. Physical Geography and Major Landforms. Climate, Atmosphere and Ocean Currents. Geography of India and Andhra Pradesh. Natural Resources, Agriculture and Industries. Transport, Communication and Tourism. Human Development, Population and Urbanization. Natural Hazards and Disaster Management. Family, Marriage, Kinship, Caste and Tribe. Religion, Ethnicity and Women. Social Issues and Regionalism. Crime Against Women and Child Labour. Public Welfare Policies and Programmes. Constitutional and Statutory Provisions for Vulnerable Groups. International Current Events. National Current Events. Andhra Pradesh Current Affairs. Logical Reasoning and Analytical Reasoning. Statement and Assumptions. Statement and Arguments. Statement and Conclusions. Number and Letter Series. Coding and Decoding. Relations and Shapes. Percentages, Ratio and Proportion. Simple and Compound Interest. Time and Work, Time and Distance. Data Interpretation and Basic Numeracy.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Mains Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The Group 2 Main Examination includes two papers covering Andhra Pradesh social history, the Indian Constitution, Indian and Andhra Pradesh Economy, and Science and Technology. Prehistoric Cultures in Andhra Pradesh. Satavahanas, Ikshvakus and Vishnukundins. Eastern Chalukyas and Andhra Cholas. Social and Cultural Development from the 11th to 16th Century. Andhra Under British Rule. Growth of the National Movement in Andhra Pradesh. Andhra Movement and Formation of Andhra State in 1953. Formation of Andhra Pradesh and Important Developments from 1956 to 2014. Constitutional Development and Salient Features. Preamble, Fundamental Rights and Directive Principles. Fundamental Duties and Constitutional Amendments. Legislature, Executive and Judiciary. Judicial Review and Judicial Activism. Centre-State Relations. Constitutional Bodies, RTI, Lokpal and Lokayukta. Elections, Electoral Reforms and Anti-Defection Law. 73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendments. Structure of Indian Economy and Economic Planning. National Income, Economic Growth and Development. Economic Reforms and NITI Aayog. Money, Banking, RBI and Monetary Policy. Inflation, Fiscal Policy and GST. Agriculture, Industry and Services Sector. Andhra Pradesh State Economy and Public Finance. AP Agriculture and Allied Sectors. Industrial Development, MSMEs and IT Sector in Andhra Pradesh. Science and Technology Policies and Missions. Space Technology and Indian Space Missions. Defence Technology and DRDO. Information Technology, Digital India and Cyber Security. Nuclear Technology and Energy Policy. Renewable and Non-Renewable Energy. Ecology, Ecosystems and Biodiversity. Environmental Pollution and Waste Management. Climate Change and Sustainable Development. Public Health, Disease Burden and Healthcare Initiatives.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Computer Proficiency Test 2026
content_sections.text: The notification includes a Computer Proficiency Test (CPT) scheme assessing computer operation, office automation, word processing, spreadsheets and presentation software. The detailed notification should be checked for the posts to which this test applies. Computer Fundamentals and Peripheral Devices. Computer Hardware and Software. Windows, Linux and Mac Operating Systems. Internet and Email Concepts. MS Word or Equivalent Word Processing Software. MS Excel or Equivalent Spreadsheet Software. Presentation Software such as MS PowerPoint. File Management and Office Automation. Typing, Document Formatting, Tables, Charts and Presentations.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for APPSC Group 2 Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can submit their applications for APPSC Group 2 Recruitment 2026 through the official Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission website from 10 November to 30 November 2026. Visit the official APPSC website at https://psc.ap.gov.in/ . Find Brief Notification No. 37/2026 for Group-II Services. Read the detailed recruitment notification and post-wise eligibility conditions when published. Open the official online application facility for Group-II Recruitment 2026. Follow the registration or login procedure specified by APPSC. Complete the personal, educational and other required details accurately. Select the relevant posts according to your eligibility and the application instructions. Complete the remaining application requirements prescribed in the detailed notification. Review and submit the application before 30 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. Retain the submitted application details for future reference. Important: APPSC accepts applications only through the prescribed online mode. Candidates should read the detailed notification before submitting the application.
